answer: A tundra delta freezes 30 beacon towers for 20 minutes. Each tower flashes a block-seeded code, read live, never pre-solved; three strangers countersign, two towers each. Entry locks 85 POA, +60 per extra identity from one root, and six more symbols per extra fake: ten fakes lock 3,550 POA; the tenth reads 54 more, past the window. One operator tends two towers at most: ten fakes need five hands, ten readings, thirty signatures, fifteen strangers. Missed flashes burn 30; one pair of eyes on two towers voids both. The ledger files each reading’s delta against its root; one root, no claim.
